intro: Body and blood. These trade HP, defense and the Defend action for raw force.

vows.name: Vow of the Open Wound
vows.boon: +40% melee strength.
vows.cost: You can no longer Defend.
vows.flavour: A guarded blow is a hesitant one.

vows.name: Oath of Iron Skin
vows.boon: +50% defense.
vows.cost: -30% melee strength.
vows.flavour: Become the wall, and forget how to be the hammer.

vows.name: Pact of the Last Breath
vows.boon: Below 25% HP, all damage you deal is doubled.
vows.cost: HP potions cannot be used.
vows.flavour: Only the dying know how hard they can strike.

vows.name: Blood Tithe
vows.boon: +30% element strength.
vows.cost: Elemental attacks cost HP instead of MP.
vows.flavour: The element drinks, and it prefers you.

vows.name: Covenant of the Martyr
vows.boon: Once per run, survive a killing blow with 1 HP.
vows.cost: -25% max HP for the rest of the run.
vows.flavour: Death is refused once. It remembers the insult.

circle: Second Circle — Vows of the Element
intro: Mana, overcharge and matchups. For players who live and die by their element.

vows.name: Covenant of the Unchanging
vows.boon: True Form unlocks at level 10 instead of 15; +25% element strength.
vows.cost: You can never rebind or reroll your element.
vows.flavour: Mastery is a door that only opens inward.

vows.name: Oath of the Hollow Vessel
vows.boon: Charge restores double MP.
vows.cost: Max MP is halved.
vows.flavour: A shallow cup fills quickly.

vows.name: Vow of the Overflow
vows.boon: Overcharge lasts until the end of combat instead of fading.
vows.cost: Every combat begins at 50% MP.
vows.flavour: Empty yourself, and the flood has somewhere to go.

vows.name: Oath of the Weak Point
vows.boon: Super-effective hits deal x2.0 instead of x1.5.
vows.cost: Not-effective hits deal x0.25 instead of x0.5.
vows.flavour: Strike the crack, or strike nothing at all.

vows.name: Vow of the Spent Star
vows.boon: Tier damage multiplier +50% against enemies of a lower tier.
vows.cost: Tier multiplier halved against enemies of a higher tier.
vows.flavour: A tyrant to the small; a candle to the great.

intro: Seal away one part of your kit to empower the rest. Simple, strong and easy to read at a glance.

vows.name: Magic Restriction — Vow of the Sealed Blade
vows.boon: +60% element (magic) strength.
vows.cost: You cannot use melee attacks.
vows.flavour: The blade is set down so the voice may carry.

vows.name: Melee Restriction — Vow of the Silent Tongue
vows.boon: +60% melee strength.
vows.cost: You cannot use elemental (magic) attacks.
vows.flavour: Words fail. Steel does not.

vows.name: Guard Restriction — Vow of the Bare Soul
vows.boon: +35% melee and element strength.
vows.cost: You cannot equip a helmet, chest or boots.
vows.flavour: Armour is a promise you intend to survive. Make no such promise.

vows.name: Potion Restriction — Oath of the Empty Satchel
vows.boon: +30% max HP.
vows.cost: You cannot drink potions during combat.
vows.flavour: What you carry in, you carry out. Nothing more.

vows.name: Awakening Restriction — Vow of Eternal Slumber
vows.boon: +20% to all stats, permanently.
vows.cost: You can never Awaken.
vows.flavour: The power sleeps in you, and you let it lie.

vows.name: Charge Restriction — Vow of the Dry Well
vows.boon: Regain 10% MP automatically every combat turn.
vows.cost: You cannot use Charge.
vows.flavour: Do not draw from the well. Let the rain come to you.

vows.name: Evolution Restriction — Oath of the Humble Root
vows.boon: True Form multiplier becomes x6 instead of x4.
vows.cost: Your element can never evolve above Tier 1 (True Form still allowed).
vows.flavour: The deepest roots never grow toward the sky.

vows.name: Repetition Restriction — Oath of the Changing Step
vows.boon: +40% to all damage dealt.
vows.cost: You cannot use the same combat action two turns in a row.
vows.flavour: Never the same answer twice. The enemy never learns the question.

vows.name: Defense Restriction — Vow of the Unflinching
vows.boon: Every enemy you kill restores 15% of your max HP.
vows.cost: You cannot Defend or Flee.
vows.flavour: Stand. Strike. Feed.

intro: Spins, rebinding, evolution and levelling. The gambler's circle.

vows.name: Gambler's Oath
vows.boon: Earn double reroll spins.
vows.cost: Every rebind costs a random 1–6 spins.
vows.flavour: The dice owe you nothing, but they are generous liars.

vows.name: Vow of the Rising Tier
vows.boon: Evolution rolls favour higher tiers.
vows.cost: XP required per level +50%.
vows.flavour: To climb higher, climb slower.

vows.name: Oath of the Rootless
vows.boon: The first rebind on each stage is free.
vows.cost: You cannot rebind during a stage's final room / boss.
vows.flavour: A wanderer's element changes with the road.

vows.name: Vow of the Scarred Page
vows.boon: +2 stat points every level-up.
vows.cost: Stat points can never be refunded or moved.
vows.flavour: Every choice is carved, never written.

circle: Fifth Circle — Vows of the Hunt
intro: Combat rules: fleeing, turn order, awakening.

vows.name: Vow of No Retreat
vows.boon: +25% XP from every kill.
vows.cost: You can never Flee.
vows.flavour: The door behind you was bricked shut by your own hand.

vows.name: Oath of the First Strike
vows.boon: Your first attack in each combat deals triple damage.
vows.cost: The enemy always acts first.
vows.flavour: Let them swing. You will only need one answer.

vows.name: Vow of the Long Awakening
vows.boon: Awakening lasts 2 turns longer.
vows.cost: Awakening cooldown is doubled.
vows.flavour: Wake fully, then sleep deeply.

vows.name: Oath of the Early Waking
vows.boon: Awakening is available from level 1.
vows.cost: Each Awakening costs 20% of your max HP.
vows.flavour: You woke before your body was ready. It will make you pay.

vows.name: Hunter's Vow
vows.boon: Enemy item drop chance doubled (30% → 60%).
vows.cost: 50% more enemies spawn each stage.
vows.flavour: The dungeon feeds those who feed on it.

circle: Sixth Circle — Vows of the Dark

vows.name: Vow of the Guttering Torch
vows.boon: Chests roll one rarity step higher.
vows.cost: Torch radius shrinks from 5.5 to 3 tiles.
vows.flavour: Treasure glitters brightest where no light reaches.

vows.name: Oath of the Starved
vows.boon: +1 stat point per level-up and HP regenerates slowly while exploring.
vows.cost: You cannot drink potions.
vows.flavour: Hunger is a whetstone.

vows.name: Vow of the Empty Hand
vows.boon: Melee strength gains +2 per level.
vows.cost: You cannot equip a weapon.
vows.flavour: Steel is a crutch for those who doubt their fists.

vows.name: Covenant of Bare Iron
vows.boon: Armour defense boosts are doubled.
vows.cost: Armour grants no element boosts.
vows.flavour: Iron does not care what burns inside you.

vows.name: Vow of Poverty
vows.boon: Every chest is guaranteed Rare or better.
vows.cost: Enemies never drop items.
vows.flavour: Take only from the dead who hid their wealth.

intro: High-risk run-definers. Consider unlocking these only after clearing stage 3, or after a first victory.

vows.name: The Eclipse Covenant
vows.boon: All tier damage multipliers are doubled.
vows.cost: You lose 3% max HP every combat turn.
vows.flavour: Sun and moon in one hand — and the hand is burning.

vows.name: Oath of One
vows.boon: Choose one stat: points spent there count one and a half times.
vows.cost: All other stats are locked at their base value.
vows.flavour: One pillar, raised to the sky. Nothing else holds the roof.

vows.name: Vow of the Unbound
vows.boon: Start the run with 10 reroll spins.
vows.cost: You begin with no element bound until you spend one.
vows.flavour: Nothing is yours until you choose it.

vows.name: Pact of the Final Stage
vows.boon: Double XP and double chest count.
vows.cost: The run ends in defeat if you die even once — no revives, no Martyr.
vows.flavour: The dungeon doubles the stakes. So do you.

vows.name: Berserker
vows.boon: +1% damage for every 10 HP you are missing.
vows.cost: Enemies deal 15% more damage to you.
vows.flavour: Every wound is a door, and the rage walks through all of them.
